thread:
anna: paging — spike of WS reconnects on /v1/stream/subscribe in eu-west starting 11:03 UTC, 429 closes then immediate reconnects.

ops-bot: ALERT route=/v1/stream/subscribe region=eu-west reconnect_rate=1800/min error_breakdown={429:72%,503:8%} sample=0.6

mike: looking at client traces: js-sdk v1.6.1 removed backoff for non-1000 closes. clients hammer after 429.

rav: proxy logs sample:
[11:03:02] tenant=acme close=429 reason="quota"
[11:03:02] tenant=acme reconnect=1
[11:03:03] tenant=acme reconnect=2

anna: suggestion: reinstate expo backoff in sdk (start=300ms max=15s factor=2, jitter=0.25). also add server hint payload on close like {"retry_after_ms":1200}.

mike: agreed. i'll push a canary for eu region. rav: add telemetry tags reconnect_reason and server_retry_hint_ms. console should show per-tenant spikes not just route totals.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued js-sdk/restore-backoff -> canary:eu-west (initiated by mike)

rav: canary looks good after 10m, reconnects down ~70% for top tenant when server_hint present. opening console PR to surface tenant timeseries and a reconnect-wait heatmap.

anna: nice. leave thread open until sdk + dashboard are rolled to prod and rates stable.
